select_device.title: Select inverter
select_device.description: Multiple inverters are linked to this account. Select the inverter to monitor.

reauth.title: Re-authenticate Smart Solar Inverter
reauth.description: Update the password for your solar.siseli.com account

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check your email and password.
error.no_device: No device found for this account.
error.invalid_predictive_options: Invalid predictive mode, night window or confidence.
error.invalid_device: The selected inverter is not in the account's device list. Refresh the list and try again.
error.reauth_failed_device_missing: Re-authentication failed: the previously selected inverter is not available on this account. The existing binding has been preserved. To bind to a different inverter, remove the integration and add it again.

init.title: Smart Solar settings
init.description: Choose a category. Saving one category preserves all other settings.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: More frequent cloud requests do not make the manufacturer’s measurements newer. Bluetooth is for viewing diagnostics only. The fields show the active Bluetooth configuration. If Bluetooth was enabled elsewhere, it can remain active when this checkbox is off. Remove that external setting to disable it.

station.title: Station
station.description: Leave both coordinates empty to use the Home Assistant location. Set both coordinates when overriding the location. Power ratings describe installed equipment.

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Calculated capacity from saved settings: {battery_energy_kwh} kWh. Capacity is configured manually, not read from BMS. Enter confirmed battery-side DC power limits. Leave unconfirmed limits empty; do not substitute a device rating for a BMS measurement.

data.max_charge_power_w: Battery charge limit (DC W; blank = unknown)
data.max_discharge_power_w: Battery discharge limit (DC W; use BMS/inverter limits)

tariffs.title: Tariffs
tariffs.description: Set the electricity prices and tariff transition hours in the Home Assistant time zone. These hours are separate from the predictive assistance window.

automation.title: Automation
automation.description: Automatic energy management applies the selected strategy. These settings are distinct from a manual inverter command.

predictive.title: Predictive assistance
predictive.description: The current mode and initial mode are separate settings. The predictive night window is distinct from the tariff window. Confidence is an internal indicator, not a forecast accuracy percentage.

error.invalid_poll_interval: Poll interval must be between 3 and 30 seconds.
error.invalid_predictive_options: Invalid predictive mode, night window or confidence.

abort.options_updated: Settings saved. They apply on the next integration update.
